questions.question: Which statement best describes Microsoft Defender for Cloud?

options.text: A protection approach that can reduce exposure by limiting management-port access to approved time windows
Segmentation and network controls that restrict communication paths

questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Microsoft Defender for Cloud
questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Security posture management: a view that maps resource configuration and controls to supported compliance standards.
Secure score: verifying the identity of a person, service, or device before granting access.
Security posture management: identifying misconfigurations and recommendations that improve the security state of cloud resources.
Microsoft Defender for Cloud: a cloud security management service that helps assess security posture and protect workloads.
Microsoft Defender for Cloud: prioritized guidance for reducing identified security risks.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Microsoft Defender for Cloud — a cloud security management service that helps assess security posture and protect workloads; and Security posture management — identifying misconfigurations and recommendations that improve the security state of cloud resources.

questions.question: Select TWO correct statements about the material in this Microsoft Learn unit.

options.text: Multicloud security: security posture and protection capabilities that can extend beyond Azure to supported other-cloud environments.
Workload protection: Microsoft Entra capabilities for integrating and controlling access to cloud and on-premises applications.
Workload protection: a protection approach that can reduce exposure by limiting management-port access to approved time windows.
Workload protection: Defender capabilities that detect threats and protect supported cloud workloads.
Multicloud security: using one identity sign-in to access multiple trusted applications.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Workload protection — Defender capabilities that detect threats and protect supported cloud workloads; and Multicloud security — security posture and protection capabilities that can extend beyond Azure to supported other-cloud environments.
